login.form.purpose: the email or password field of the Facebook login form

page.blocked.purpose: a notice that the account may not use Marketplace or is blocked

page.pin_prompt.purpose: Messenger asking for the chat history PIN

create.photos.purpose: the file input that takes photos on the create item form

create.title.purpose: the Title text input of the listing form

create.price.purpose: the Price text input of the listing form

create.category.purpose: the Category dropdown of the listing form

create.condition.purpose: the Condition dropdown of the listing form

create.description.purpose: the Description text area of the listing form

create.next.purpose: the Next button at the bottom of the create item form

create.publish.purpose: the Publish button that posts the new listing

dialog.not_now.purpose: the Not now button of a prompt shown after publishing (boost, share)

edit.save.purpose: the button that saves changes on the edit listing form (Update or Save)

item.gone.purpose: the notice that a listing no longer exists

specs.text: This listing is no longer available

item.mark_sold.purpose: the Mark as sold button on the seller's own listing page

item.mark_available.purpose: the button that puts a sold listing back on sale

sold.confirm.purpose: a button that finishes the mark as sold dialog without naming a buyer

item.more.purpose: the More options (three dots) button on the seller's own listing page

item.delete.purpose: the Delete listing entry of the listing's More options menu

delete.confirm.purpose: the Delete button that confirms deleting a listing

selling.card.purpose: one listing card on Your listings

specs.css: xpath=//a[contains(@href, '/marketplace/item/')]/ancestor::div[contains(., 'clicks on listing') or contains(., 'Mark as sold') or contains(., 'Mark as available')][1]

selling.item_link.purpose: the link to the listing inside a Your listings card

inbox.thread_list.purpose: the list of chats in Messenger

inbox.marketplace_folder.purpose: the Marketplace row in the Messenger chat list that opens all Marketplace chats

inbox.thread_link.purpose: a link to one Marketplace chat in the chat list

inbox.unread.purpose: the unread marker inside a chat row

thread.message.purpose: one message bubble in an open chat

thread.heading.purpose: the heading of an open chat naming the buyer and the listing

thread.listing_link.purpose: the See details link from an open chat to its listing

thread.buyer_link.purpose: the link to the buyer's profile in an open chat

thread.input.purpose: the message text box of an open chat

thread.send.purpose: the send button of an open chat

thread.rate_limited.purpose: a notice that Messenger blocked sending
